items.label: All-Inclusive Marble Extravaganza
items.value: Our 236 Pcs Elevator Marble Run Toy Set is here to take Play period to new heights! Including 176 vibrant track pieces, 15 sleek plastic marbles, 30 glow-in-the-dark marbles, and 15 classic glass marbles, this marble tower is a complete "marbel run" masterpiece.

items.label: Innovative Elevator Magic
items.value: The unique elevator feature elevates this marble race track from cool to WOW! It's a rush watching marbles climb up and slide down in an endless loop, ensuring the marble run never stops.

items.label: Sturdy and Higher Quality
items.value: Made with durable materials, our marble runs for kids withstand the test of Play period. This marble set is crafted to last, ensuring countless hours of racing fun.

items.label: Shine with Glow Marbles
items.value: Turn off the lights and watch the race light up! Our glow marbles add an extra dazzle to your child's marble games, making the race track a radiant spectacle in the dark.

items.label: Perfect for Family Bonding
items.value: Engage in a marble race that's great for parent-child interaction. Spend quality time building and racing, creating memories with every marble set showdown.
